{"people":[{"name":"Priya","role":"account executive (rep) on the Fetchwell deal","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"product marketer / interviewer","side":"us"},{"name":"Daniel","role":"VP of Engineering at Fetchwell, final decider and signer","side":"customer"},{"name":"CFO (unnamed)","role":"Fetchwell CFO, joined one call for ten minutes","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed engineer (she)","role":"Fetchwell engineer who built the weekend prototype","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed engineer at kickoff","role":"Fetchwell engineer who said 'we'll find out'","side":"customer"},{"name":"Incumbent account manager(s)","role":"incumbent's account manager, changed three times in two years","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Braintree"],
"incumbent":"Braintree (inferred: the customer had a call with Braintree mid-evaluation, and the rep refers to 'the competitor' and PayPal/Venmo buttons; the transcript never explicitly names the incumbent)",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"They were launching Canada, then the UK, and sitters have to get paid locally.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Expansion into Canada and UK created local sitter payout need that started the evaluation."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"\"a haunted house.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own description of their payments code."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Maintenance burden on the existing payments setup; 'more or less' is hedged."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"a roadmap item, faster pay for sitters, that had been pushed three quarters in a row.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Faster sitter pay was repeatedly deferred on their roadmap."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"A hundred and eighty K a year, on a three-year term.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Deal size and term."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"Connect, for paying the sitters, with Payments for the bookings.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","outcome"],"note":"Products sold: Connect for sitter payouts plus Payments for bookings."},
{"id":"E7","turn":8,"excerpt":"Daniel. He signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Daniel signed the deal."},
{"id":"E8","turn":8,"excerpt":"The CFO joined one call for ten minutes, asked one question, \"does this change when sitters get paid?\", and left.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"CFO had minimal involvement; his one question was about sitter pay timing."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"\"this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Daniel stated early that engineering owns the decision."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"Their account manager had changed three times in two years.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent service churn; relayed from the customer."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"\"I've stopped learning their names.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Daniel's frustration with incumbent account manager turnover."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"A lot of pet owners pay with PayPal and Venmo, and they were nervous about what happens to those buttons.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"Customer worry about PayPal/Venmo checkout buttons after switching."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"They had a call with Braintree in the middle of the evaluation.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Customer spoke with Braintree mid-evaluation; the rep inferred it from question changes."},
{"id":"E14","turn":12,"excerpt":"I know because the questions changed. It went from \"how fast can we build this\" to \"what do we lose.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Observed shift in customer questions from build speed to loss concerns."},
{"id":"E15","turn":12,"excerpt":"Do we lose PayPal, do we lose Venmo, what happens to the saved cards.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"Specific loss questions: PayPal, Venmo, saved cards."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"I assume Braintree told them they'd lose things. I don't know that. That's me guessing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's explicit guess about what Braintree said; not verified."},
{"id":"E17","turn":14,"excerpt":"the docs and the sandbox.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Pitch parts that got a reaction."},
{"id":"E18","turn":14,"excerpt":"One of their engineers, on her own time, built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend and showed it at Monday standup.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Customer engineer self-built prototype; rep learned of it only afterward from Daniel."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"I didn't even know until Daniel told me.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"The rep was not aware of the prototype as it happened."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"And the marketplace piece. Onboarding sitters, the identity checks, paying out in local currency.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Marketplace features also drew a reaction, though customer says 'the app'."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence: the acceptance-rate slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Acceptance-rate slide got no engagement."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"\"our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Daniel dismissed auth-rate improvement as irrelevant at a $38 average booking."},
{"id":"E23","turn":16,"excerpt":"The weekend prototype. Before that it was a bake-off.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","competitor"],"note":"Rep's win moment; before it the evaluation was a competitive bake-off."},
{"id":"E24","turn":16,"excerpt":"After that Daniel stopped saying \"if.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Observed change in Daniel's language after the prototype."},
{"id":"E25","turn":18,"excerpt":"Nothing, really. It was a clean one.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep claims no gaps; contradicted later by PayPal/Venmo and saved-card answers."},
{"id":"E26","turn":20","excerpt":"We kind of danced around it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Admits evasion on PayPal/Venmo."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"We said they could keep offering PayPal and we'd work through the details in implementation.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"What was told to the customer on PayPal; details deferred."},
{"id":"E28","turn":20,"excerpt":"I didn't have a crisp answer on Venmo in the room, and I still don't.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Venmo question remains unanswered."},
{"id":"E29","turn":20,"excerpt":"They decided it was a risk they'd take.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep's characterization of customer's acceptance of PayPal/Venmo risk; no customer words given."},
{"id":"E30","turn":22,"excerpt":"We walked them through moving saved cards over so nobody has to re-enter anything.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Saved-card migration was explained."},
{"id":"E31","turn":22,"excerpt":"But it was a doc and a conversation.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Saved-card handling had no demo or proof, only a document and talk."},
{"id":"E32","turn":22,"excerpt":"\"who's done this at our size without losing cards?\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Daniel asked for a reference at his scale."},
{"id":"E33","turn":22,"excerpt":"I said I'd get back to him. I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep never followed up on Daniel's reference request."},
{"id":"E34","turn":24,"excerpt":"Once, in the kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Daniel raised the saved-card issue again only once, at kickoff, after signing."},
{"id":"E35","turn":24,"excerpt":"\"we'll find out.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Customer engineer at kickoff","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Engineer's response at kickoff; saved-card question stays unresolved."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"\"Payments shouldn't be a team,\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Daniel's recurring phrase."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"\"We want to stop babysitting this.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel, VP of Engineering","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Customer's framing: payments maintenance burden."},
{"id":"E38","turn":26,"excerpt":"On the sitter side it's \"paid by Friday.\" The whole promise to sitters is paid by Friday.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's sitter-facing promise is 'paid by Friday'."},
{"id":"E39","turn":26,"excerpt":"Nobody there says \"marketplace.\" They say \"the app.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer says 'the app', not 'marketplace'."},
{"id":"E40","turn":26,"excerpt":"And nobody says \"payouts.\" They say \"sitter pay.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer says 'sitter pay', not 'payouts'."},
{"id":"E41","turn":28,"excerpt":"Only that I barely sold this. Their engineer did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","message"],"note":"Rep's view that the customer's engineer, not sales, drove the win."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E25","E26","E28"],"what":"Rep said 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one' about what could not be shown, then admitted dancing around PayPal and having no Venmo answer."},
{"evidence":["E25","E31","E33"],"what":"Rep called it clean, yet the saved-card reference request went unanswered and the proof was only a doc and conversation."},
{"evidence":["E7","E9","E18","E41"],"what":"Daniel is named as decider and signer, but the rep says an unnamed engineer's prototype effectively won the deal and she barely sold it."},
{"evidence":["E20","E39"],"what":"Rep says the marketplace piece drew a reaction, but also reports nobody at the customer uses the word 'marketplace'."},
{"evidence":["E29","E15","E28"],"what":"Rep says the customer chose to take the PayPal/Venmo risk, yet worry about losing PayPal, Venmo and saved cards drove their questions and the Venmo question was never answered."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":18,"what":"Answered 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one,' then at T20 and T22 admitted the PayPal/Venmo evasion and the unanswered saved-card reference request."},
{"question":"Earlier you said they were nervous about the PayPal and Venmo buttons. What did we show them on that?","turn":20,"what":"Opened with a pause, 'danced around it', deferred to implementation, and had no Venmo answer."},
{"question":"Did he raise it again?","turn":24,"what":"Answered only that it came up once at kickoff, with the engineer's 'we'll find out'; no resolution or follow-up given."}
],
"skipped":["trigger is answered but the timing of the evaluation start is not given; no question asked about who the other evaluated vendors were or whether Braintree was the incumbent","competitor: the incumbent is never named and the competitive set is not stated"],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the app","ours":"marketplace","evidence":["E39","E20"]},
{"theirs":"sitter pay","ours":"payouts","evidence":["E40"]},
{"theirs":"paid by Friday","ours":"acceptance-rate / average improvement customers see","evidence":["E38","E21","E22"]},
{"theirs":"a haunted house / Payments shouldn't be a team / stop babysitting this","ours":"Connect and Payments product pitch","evidence":["E2","E36","E37","E6"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E5"],"what":"Won: Daniel signed a $180K per year, three-year deal."},
{"evidence":["E6"],"what":"Both Connect (sitter payouts) and Payments (bookings) were sold; the transcript does not say whether any part of the business stayed elsewhere."},
{"evidence":["E28","E33","E35"],"what":"Venmo and saved-card questions remained unresolved at signing and kickoff, so some open risk persists after close."},
{"evidence":["E18","E24","E41"],"what":"The rep attributes the turn from bake-off to confidence to the customer engineer's weekend prototype."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep said 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one' about what could not be shown, then admitted dancing around PayPal and having no Venmo answer.
Rep called it clean, yet the saved-card reference request went unanswered and the proof was only a doc and conversation.

Rep says the customer chose to take the PayPal/Venmo risk, yet worry about losing PayPal, Venmo and saved cards drove their questions and the Venmo question was never answered.
